shots.title: Expire or close stale workflow executions by merged branch, newer sprint, or age (#503)
shots.notes: Extracted workflow reconciliation into `src/cli/workflow-resync.ts` and extended stale execution detection to scorecards, complete/superseded roadmap entries, newer branch/running sprint evidence, and age.

shots.title: Add workflow resync path that fast-forwards execution state from branch and commits (#503)

hazards.description: Architect review caught that newer-running-sprint stale detection was too broad for edit-time guard reconciliation; the guard now disables that reason while explicit cleanup keeps it.

shots.notes: Added `slope sprint workflow resync` and guard-side reconciliation that can fast-forward a branch sprint to the per-ticket agent-work step when matching sprint commits already exist.

shots.title: Scope PR creation gate to branch-inferred sprint and rebind stale sprint-state (#503)
shots.notes: The PR creation guard now rebinds stale sprint-state to the branch-inferred sprint before checking scorecard and gates, so an S66 PR is not blocked by stale S65 state.

shots.title: Add stale S65/S66 workflow and PR gate drift regressions (#503)
shots.notes: Added regressions for newer-sprint cleanup, aged executions, branch-commit workflow fast-forward, workflow-step-gate auto-resync, and PR-gate sprint-state rebind.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite continues to emit known temp-repo stderr noise, but all tests passed.

training.description: Cleanup commands can be more assertive than edit-time guards.
training.outcome: Newer running sprint detection is enabled for explicit cleanup/resync but disabled for workflow-step-gate reconciliation.

training.description: Workflow state should reconcile before guards enforce it.
training.outcome: The workflow-step gate now pauses stale executions and fast-forwards proven branch-local work before deciding whether to block edits.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts tests/cli/guards/workflow-step-gate.test.ts tests/cli/guards/sprint-completion.test.ts` passed: 78 tests.

`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Substantial but steady. The underlying issue was not one guard being wrong; it was multiple guards trusting stale local state without first reconciling reality.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a guard consumes durable workflow state, give it a conservative reconciliation pass before enforcement.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The explicit cleanup heuristic was too strong for edit-time use until it became configurable.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S142 can focus on codebase-map safety with a clearer pattern for conservative guard reconciliation.

bunker_locations: Do not use newer-running-sprint evidence inside edit guards unless the current branch also supports it.
Fast-forwarding workflow state should also synchronize sprint-state so guards agree on the lifecycle phase.
PR creation gates should infer branch sprint before enforcing gates from persisted sprint-state.
yardage_book_updates: `src/cli/workflow-resync.ts` centralizes workflow execution staleness, branch sprint inference, workflow fast-forwarding, and sprint-state rebinding.
`slope sprint workflow resync` reconciles stale and branch-drifted workflow executions.
`workflow-step-gate` now reconciles executions before blocking edits on non-agent-work steps.
`sprint-completion` now rebinds stale sprint-state to the branch-inferred sprint before PR gate checks.
course_management_notes: Validation passed: focused S141 tests, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, `corepack pnpm test`, and `slope roadmap validate`.
